mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_records (user_id, eat_date, eat_time, meal_type, memo, diet_img_url, total_calories, total_carbohydrate, total_protein, total_fat) VALUES (#{userId}, #{eatDate}, #{eatTime}, #{mealType}, #{memo}, #{dietImgUrl}, #{totalCalories}, #{totalCarbohydrate}, #{totalProtein}, #{totalFat})
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, dd.diet_detail_id, dd.food_id, dd.food_name, dd.quantity, dd.unit, dd.calories AS d_calories, dd.carbohydrate AS d_carbohydrate, dd.protein AS d_protein, dd.fat AS d_fat FROM diet_records d LEFT JOIN diet_details dd ON d.diet_id = dd.diet_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.eat_date = #{eatDate} ORDER BY d.eat_time ASC

SELECT d.*, dd.diet_detail_id, dd.food_id, dd.food_name, dd.quantity, dd.unit, dd.calories AS d_calories, dd.carbohydrate AS d_carbohydrate, dd.protein AS d_protein, dd.fat AS d_fat FROM diet_records d LEFT JOIN diet_details dd ON d.diet_id = dd.diet_id WHERE d.diet_id = #{dietId}
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_records SET eat_time = #{eatTime}, meal_type = #{mealType}, memo = #{memo}, diet_img_url = #{dietImgUrl}, total_calories = #{totalCalories}, total_carbohydrate = #{totalCarbohydrate}, total_protein = #{totalProtein}, total_fat = #{totalFat}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE diet_id = #{dietId}
